access.actor_scope: Role-specific parser/model/calibrator/policy/auditor counters supplied by custody; mixed-source byte capture is separate.

scope.cost_scope: Logical recorded-row YS/E bundle requests; no physical experiment cost claim.
scope.custody_scope: Completed ledgers are audited by the kernel; active access capabilities and external identity checks belong to upstream custody.
scope.endpoint_scope: Recorded column 11 YS in MPa and column 13 elongation in percentage points; uncertainty not interpreted and specimen pairing not verified.
scope.identity_scope: Supplied whole-artifact identities are bound, not independently authenticated by this projector.
scope.metric_scope: Exact descriptive archival replay aggregates; no conditional coverage or deployment claim.
scope.population: Fixed archived source-token panels; rows are recorded entries, not verified specimens.
scope.privacy_scope: Aggregate projection only; no record IDs, memberships, targets, neighbors, predictions, orders, cell hashes or local paths.
scope.source_scope: Lexical source-group separation does not establish chemical, specimen or study independence.
scope.statistical_claim: Conditional single-future-panel marginal retention under the frozen score law; no simultaneous evaluation-panel claim.
scope.threshold_scope: Derived lower median of complete development-row elongation; not an independently specified engineering requirement.
